thread:
Marta: Proposing RC build rc-2026-04b for origination. Artifact: sha:7c9d1f4. Need quick QA ack and pin before quiet window.
Samira: What are the quiet/promo windows tonight?
Marta: Quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC, promo at 22:30 UTC. Plan: pin rc-2026-04b to sha:7c9d1f4 everywhere.
Patrick: Staging smoke done. Quick eval: 12/12 checks passed. Two flaky ranking tests surfaced but marked non-blocking (details: http://ci/runs/445).
QA-Jen: Confirming smoke and perf baseline. p95 unchanged, small token cost delta (+0.6%).
Charlie: Ops rollout plan: canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% after another 15m. KV-warm scheduled at T-10m pre-promote.
Marta: Draft release notes below; add callouts.
Samira: ack from Product. Add product note: tokenization tweak may break a small set of legacy templates; include upgrade snippet.
Patrick: Note for infra: embeddings index migration will run as read-only for first 24h; old index remains available for fallback.
Marta: Pinning to ensure artifact immutability.
deploy-bot: /pin rc-2026-04b sha:7c9d1f4
deploy-bot: Pin successful: rc-2026-04b -> sha:7c9d1f4
Marta: Assigning on-call responsibilities: Charlie primary sheriff, Samira backup.
Charlie: I'm on deck. Watching latency, 5xxs, and error budget. Alerts and runbook live.
Patrick: Rollback criteria we agreed on: sustained error rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 50% sustained for 5m -> rollback to rc-2026-03 (sha:a2b4c3d).
Samira: Manual or auto rollback?
Charlie: Manual rollback via deploy-bot unless SRE auto-rollback triggers. I'll execute if thresholds hit.
Marta: Final go?
Samira: green
Patrick: green
QA-Jen: green
Charlie: green
Marta: Final promote command (staged canary):
```
deploybot promote --rc rc-2026-04b --pin sha:7c9d1f4 --canary 5 --region global
```
Marta: Timeline: trigger at 22:25 UTC (T-5), canary at 22:30, step to 25% at +10m, full at +25m if healthy. I'll post timestamps when I trigger.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary promotion for 2026-11-15T22:30:00Z
Charlie: I'll have emergency rollback command prepped and will notify on-call if thresholds breach.
Marta: Release notes (draft):
- RC-2026-04b: runtime fixes and tokenization improvements
- Pin: sha:7c9d1f4 to ensure deterministic deploys
- Notes: embeddings index migration is read-only for 24h; legacy template upgrade snippet required for a subset of customers
- Known CI flake: two ranking tests (non-blocking)
- Rollback target: rc-2026-03 (sha:a2b4c3d)
Samira: I'll write product-facing blurb and forward to marketing after promo completes.
Marta: I'll publish release-notes after promo and post a 30m rollout readout here.
Charlie: Will monitor and report any anomalies.
Marta: End of thread, publishing pin and preparing for T-5 trigger.
